name: regime-risk
description: Predict forward risk on SPY and QQQ. Score skill against a vol-only baseline, then test whether that skill cuts drawdown without giving up Sharpe after costs.

metric.explanation: Brier skill score against the vol-only baseline B1. 0 means the model is no better than trailing volatility and VIX. 0.05 is the pre-registered gate. Higher is better. There is no floor: a negative score means the model is worse than B1 and the gate fails.

data_description: Daily bars from stockdb stock_data on 192.168.1.196 via get_daily_bars, using adjclose for returns. Intraday Tier A reads frozen 15-minute cells and signal pools under experiments/indicator-combo/data. No market.stock_* queries.
context: Four-week forward-risk sprint. Indicator strategies are closed. Every model must beat the vol-only baseline B1. Holdout 2022-01-03 through 2024-09-27 is human-only and runs once.
goals: Find whether features beyond trailing vol and VIX predict 5-day downside, vol expansion, or realized vol well enough to reduce drawdown versus buy-and-hold at equal or better Sharpe after 2 bps per side.
